title: Reviewer Return JSON (spec-workflow v1.2.0)
description: Contract that EVERY reviewer agent (spec/plan/tasks/consistency/code + qa-tester) returns to the orchestrator. Reviewers are read-only: they NEVER write marker files (M2). The orchestrator validates this JSON for self-consistency before writing the .xxx-passed marker.

reportFile.description: Project-relative path to the markdown report the reviewer wrote to reviews/.

reviewerSelfReport.description: Replaces the meaningless self-attesting reviewerAgent:true field (M4). Provenance metadata only — NOT a pass attestation.

adversarialJustification.description: Required when criticalCount=0 and warningCount=0: why no issues were found.
